Container.Name: llama.cpp-CUDA-Router
Container.Overview:
llama.cpp Docker container for NVIDIA GPUs. Configured in Router Mode to support multiple models with automatic model loading and unloading. Includes configurable inference settings such as context size, GPU offloading, KV-cache precision, reasoning controls, Jinja templates, and parallel processing.
Not actively and/or very poorly maintained because I don't know what the hell I'm doing.

Config.Name: API / Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host TCP port for the llama.cpp API and Web UI. Default: 8000. The container listens on TCP 8000.

Config.Name: Server Bind Address
Config.Description: Network interface inside container. 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces; 127.0.0.1 = loopback only. Use 0.0.0.0 for Docker bridge access.

Config.Name: Internal Server Port
Config.Description: Internal llama.cpp listening port. Default: 8000. Changing this also requires updating the Docker port mapping and health check.

Config.Name: Model Storage Directory
Config.Description: Host directory containing GGUF model files and models.ini, mounted as /models inside the container.

Config.Name: Model Presets File
Config.Description: Path to the multi-model router preset inside the container. Default: /models/models.ini. Each [model-name] section defines an available model.

Config.Name: Maximum Loaded Models
Config.Description: Maximum models resident simultaneously. 1 = one at a time; 0 = unlimited. Choose based on GPU memory.

Config.Name: Automatic Model Loading
Config.Description: Accepted values: true / false. true automatically loads an available model when a request selects it; it does not preload every model at startup.

Config.Name: Model Download Cache Directory
Config.Description: Persistent host directory for the llama.cpp download cache. Container mount: /root/.cache/llama.cpp. Verify actual cache path for your image/build.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPU device selector. all = all NVIDIA GPUs; a GPU UUID can select one specific device. Requires NVIDIA container runtime.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Comma-separated NVIDIA driver features exposed to the container. Default: compute,utility. compute enables CUDA; utility enables device information such as nvidia-smi.

Config.Name: GPU Offload Layers
Config.Description: Number of model layers offloaded to NVIDIA GPU. 99 requests full offload for most models; reduce to fit available VRAM.

Config.Name: GPU KV Cache Precision — Keys
Config.Description: Common values: f16 / q8_0 / q4_0. Controls KV attention-key cache precision; supported values vary by model and llama.cpp build.

Config.Name: GPU KV Cache Precision — Values
Config.Description: Common values: f16 / q8_0 / q4_0. Controls KV attention-value cache precision; supported values vary by model and llama.cpp build.

Config.Name: Inference Context Size (Tokens)
Config.Description: Maximum token context for a loaded model worker. Default: 16384. Higher values can increase memory use.

Config.Name: Inference Parallel Slots
Config.Description: Number of concurrently processed request slots per worker. Default: 1. More slots can increase KV-cache memory consumption.

Config.Name: Jinja Chat Templates
Config.Description: Accepted values: true / false. Enables compatible Jinja chat templates used by model-specific prompt formatting.

Config.Name: Reasoning Mode
Config.Description: Accepted values: auto / on / off. Controls whether model reasoning is requested where supported.

Config.Name: Reasoning Output Format
Config.Description: Listed options: auto / none / deepseek / deepseek-legacy. Selects how supported reasoning is represented in API output.

Config.Name: Reasoning Token Budget
Config.Description: Reasoning token budget. -1 = unrestricted; 0 = no thinking budget; positive integer = configured budget. Model support varies.
